SimHub telemetry, lower avoidable CPU overhead and stability fixes. **Huge thanks to Markus Stahl** for both community patches, the performance improvements and all his continued help with this project.

### Changes

- **SimHub integration:** Live frame timings, render resolutions, rendered FOV and status under `LmuQuadView.*`, plus actions to toggle the benchmark overlay and recording. The plugin reads telemetry; actions signal the launcher. Build it against your local SimHub installation using `simhub/build-simhub-plugin.ps1`. Enable Diagnostics and Benchmark, and keep the launcher open for actions.
- **Lower overhead:** Share render-hook pointer validation, throttle repeated failure logs and avoid routine per-frame allocations in gaze synchronization and VRS overlay submission. Context validation runs only when needed.
- **Profiler memory:** Allocate sample buffers only while profiling is enabled, and release them when disabled or the session ends. DLL size, allocated memory and resident RAM are different measurements.
- **Stability:** Validate missing OpenXR extension and frame-layer lists; handle protected-process queries and benchmark polling errors in the launcher; preserve its STA entry point.
- **Hardening:** Restrict elevated installer DLL lookup, protect telemetry and action channels, verify overlay snapshots, reject implausible timings and restrict scripts/external content in benchmark reports.
- **Cleanup and telemetry:** Remove stale generated update downloads, expire old measurements and reconnect SimHub after LMU exits and restarts.

### Performance expectations

In my benchmark scenario, I observed around **1–1.5 ms lower CPU frametime with 0.5.1**. This is a result from my own setup and scene, not a guaranteed improvement across systems.

Quad Views still needs sufficient CPU headroom. Earlier testing and reports put the CPU penalty at roughly **3–4 ms versus no mod**; the remaining overhead with 0.5.1 depends on the setup and workload. GPU gains can still be outweighed when CPU-limited. SPS/MVR is not enabled.

### Downloads and updating

Choose **`LMU-Quad-View-Mod-0.5.1-Setup-x64.exe`** for installation or **`LMU-Quad-View-Mod-0.5.1.zip`** for portable use. Both contain timestamped, signed native binaries and the launcher. The optional SimHub plugin is supplied as source for local compilation.

Close LMU and the old launcher before updating. Preserve `launcher-settings.xml` and `profiles` when moving a portable package. Open the new launcher, save your settings and run **Setup > Install / update automatic startup** to update Steam startup to the new binaries.

### Validation

Native MSVC tests including 80 OpenXR scenarios, launcher/layout/slider tests, native-to-C# telemetry and command tests, and compilation against an installed SimHub SDK passed. Actual in-game SimHub dashboards, physical button bindings and performance across other setups and scenes still need community testing.
